poems.title: The Ministry of Complicated Things
poemText: Their job is to complicate the simple things
They turn a declaration of love
into a contract with clauses in fine print
They speak a language that nobody understands
so they can sell the solutions
They are the high priests of confusion
and they are afraid of only one thing

poems.title: The Dance of the Dead Leaves
poemText: The fallen leaves are not dead
one last waltz before the long sleep
They dance to remember the summer
the sun warm upon their green skin
the song of the birds in their branches
They dance to forget the coming winter
the cold the snow the silence
it is just another way of traveling

poems.title: The Thief of Sleep
poemText: At night he slips into bedrooms
and takes the sleep from people
stuffing it into a great sack
In the morning people wake up weary
with dark shadows under their eyes
they do not know their rest has been stolen
who cannot rest because of the pain

poems.title: The Song of the Crack
poemText: I am a crack in a wall
a tiny line of nothing at all
People look at me with contempt
a small window to the other side
I let in a little light
I am the proof that nothing is perfect
I am the small necessary wound

poems.title: The Last Train
poemText: The last train of the night
is full of people who do not want to go home
The student who is afraid of his exams
the worker who is afraid of his wife
the lover who is afraid of loneliness
The lights of the houses are eyes that judge
The train is a Noah's Ark of sorrow
each person alone with their grief
The train arrives at the end of the line

poems.title: The Museum of Simple Things
poemText: In this museum there are no masterpieces
Each object is in a glass display case
"The cup from which my father drank his coffee"
"The button from the dress of my first love"
"The flower he gave me before going to war"
It is the museum of the memory of the heart
their own cups their own buttons
and they understand that the true value
but in the love that settled

poems.title: The Revolt of the Punctuation Marks
poemText: I am tired of ending everything
I am weary of making pauses
I no longer want to doubt
without breath without emotion without a question
a long river of gray words
it is the breath of the text
it is its music its heart

poems.title: The Merchant of Regrets
poemText: He does not sell new things
The regret of not having said "I love you"
the regret of having taken that job
the regret of not having gone away
they still have the scent of the past
to feel less alone with their own
The merchant is a wise man
he knows that the only way to get rid of a regret

poems.title: The Sidewalk's Prayer
poemText: let my surface be walked upon
let your kingdom of pedestrians come
their will be done on me as it is elsewhere
Give us this day our daily rain
as we forgive the chewing gum flattened upon us
and lead us not into the temptation of street repairs
but deliver us from dog droppings
for ours is the kingdom of the rushed the wanderers and lovers
for the streets of the streets

poems.title: The Ministry of Normality
poemText: Their goal is for everyone to be the same
same house same car same dog
same ideas same dreams same fears
They distribute manuals on "how to live"
The world has become a giant mirror
where everyone sees their own reflection everywhere
But one day a child laughed
with a laugh that was not in the manual
and that laughter made a crack in the giant mirror
a little bit of blue sky.

poems.title: The Dance of the Shadow Puppets
poemText: the father’s hands make shadow puppets
A dog a bird a rabbit
He does not see his father's tired hands
he does not see the worries of the day
a world where everything is possible
where animals are born from light and shadow
he becomes a magician a poet
he forgets he is just a man
with hands worn out by work
are together in the same dream
the most beautiful theater in the world.

poems.title: The Thief of Voices
poemText: he captures them in a tape recorder
He has the broken voice of the old man
the clear voice of the young girl
the loud voice of the politician
the soft voice of the mother
At night he listens to his collection
he gets drunk on all these lives
He is a thousand people at once
because he lost his own voice
against the injustice of the world
and he has only the voices of others left

poems.title: The Song of the Dust
poemText: I am the end of all things
the end of empires of loves of lives
I settle gently upon the furniture
upon the books upon the memories
I am the gray patience of time
I am the proof that everything passes
People chase me away with feather dusters
for I am the very matter of the world
I am made of dead skin and exploded stars
I am the beginning and the end

poems.title: The Last Kiosk
poemText: It is the last kiosk before the desert
The merchant asks them for nothing
he knows that in the desert
is worth more than all the gold in the banks

poems.title: The Testament of a Cloud
poemText: when I have fallen as rain
I leave you no grand last will
I leave you the puddle on the sidewalk
in which the sky reflects itself
I leave you the flower that will drink my water
and grow a little more beautiful tomorrow
I leave you the damp earth
that will smell sweetly of life
only the proof that even in vanishing
one can still give a little freshness

poems.title: The Dialogue of Hand and Glove
poemText: The hand said to the glove
You protect me from the cold
but you stop me from feeling
I protect you from the dirt
but I stop you from touching
Without you I am nothing but an empty piece of leather
So they decided never to leave each other
The hand agreed to be a little less sensitive
the glove agreed to be a little less clean
and together they faced the world

poems.title: The Revolt of the Musical Notes
poemText: I am tired of always being the beginning
I am weary of always being the end
I want to be natural for once
I would like to go up a little
So they left the sheet music
they created a new kind of music
a music without rules without a conductor
The pianist tried to catch them
but his fingers were too slow too disciplined
He had to stop and listen
and he understood that the most beautiful music
is not the one that is written down
but the one that invents itself

poems.title: The Merchant of "I Love You"
poemText: He has an "I love you" for every situation
People come to buy them from him
when they no longer have the strength to say it themselves
or when they no longer mean it
and says it to someone else
and the other person believes it
and the empty word suddenly fills up
with all the magic of the world
because he knows he has sold

poems.title: The Cigarette's Prayer
poemText: let your kingdom of nicotine come
your will be done in my lungs as it is elsewhere
Give us this day our daily puff
as we forgive those who light us up
and lead us not into the temptation of the ashtray
but deliver us from the last drag
for ours is the pleasure the cancer and the cough
join its brothers on the sidewalk.

poems.title: The Ministry of Fear
poemText: Their job is to manufacture fear
The Minister of Fear is a man who is afraid of everything
he is afraid of his shadow
he is afraid of a laughing child
and that a single burst of laughter

poems.title: The Dance of the Snowflakes
poemText: dancing a slow and cold waltz
hiding the dirt the ugliness the mistakes
They are a promise of purity

poems.title: The Thief of Endings
poemText: He steals the endings of stories
just before "they lived happily ever after"
just before "all's well that ends well"
He leaves the tales suspended in the air
with a taste of the unfinished
The characters wander without a destination
He does not do this out of cruelty
he does it because he detests endings
is the heavy door of a prison
He prefers the stories that never close
the loves that keep on going
which is the most beautiful promise

poems.title: The Song of the Chewing Gum
poemText: I was pink and full of sugar
in the mouth of a young girl
I knew the taste of her kisses
then she threw me on the sidewalk
I am the sticky memory of a fleeting pleasure
I am the small scar of passing time
I am no longer useful for anything
so that he stops for a second
the sweet taste of his own youth.

poems.title: The Prostitute's Last Customer
poemText: he did not take off his coat
no one ever asked her that
of her dreams of her fears
He listened without saying a word
Then he put the money on the table
then she looked at herself in the mirror
and for the first time in a long time
she did not see a prostitute
and she understood that this man

poems.title: The Will of a Blade of Grass
poemText: I am a blade of grass
but I have seen the sun
I have danced with the wind
One day a cow will eat me
or a mower will cut me down
I will leave no name behind
in the memory of an ant
who took shelter beneath me during a storm
I leave you my green color
and my quiet power to always grow back
even when I am trampled upon

poems.title: The Dialogue of Heart and Reason
poemText: You are reckless you are foolish
And you are cold you are calculating
you turn everything into an equation
you are afraid of anything that cannot be proven
Without me you would be nothing but a chaos of passions
Without me you would be nothing but a lifeless machine

poems.title: The Revolt of the Fairy Tales
poemText: I am tired of the wolf I want a prince charming
Enough with the prince I want to start a union for scullery maids
Sleeping Beauty woke up all by herself
A hundred years of sleep is enough I want a coffee and a newspaper
the wicked queen opened a beauty salon
but they found it much more amusing
because the characters had finally decided
to no longer be the prisoners

poems.title: The Merchant of "If Only"
poemText: It is the most potent perfume in the world
People dab a single drop behind their ear
and spend the rest of the day dreaming
about the life they never lived
It is a sweet and terrible drug
that stops you from living in the now
The merchant is a wealthy man

poems.title: The Book's Prayer
poemText: let your kingdom of readers come
your will be done on my pages as it is elsewhere
Give us this day our daily reading
as we forgive those who dog-ear our pages
and lead us not into the temptation of the bookcase
but deliver us from being forgotten
for ours is the story the imagination and the dreams

poems.title: The Ministry of the Obvious
poemText: Their job is to repeat the obvious
to prove that two and two make four
They are the guardians of the status quo
is that one day someone will stand up and say
And what if the sky were green
and what if water were dry
and what if two and two

poems.title: The Dance of Strangers
poemText: In the subway during rush hour
bodies touch brush squeeze past each other
It is a strange and involuntary dance
We feel the warmth of others
But no one looks at anyone
each person is an island of solitude
everyone returns to their own solitude

poems.title: The Thief of Time
poemText: He steals the minute when you hesitate
the hour you spend doing nothing
He puts them inside a giant clock
He says he wants to catch up with his past
but by stealing the present of others
he only creates an empty future
a future with no surprise no unexpected turns
a future where everything has already happened
He is the greatest of criminals
because he does not steal what people have

poems.title: The Song of the Chipped Cup
poemText: They put me at the very back of the cupboard
no one wants to drink from me anymore
I have a little wound of porcelain
a souvenir from a clumsy hand
or from an anger too sharp
but I am far more interesting
My chip is a little mouth
that could tell so many stories
the story of coffee served too hot
of kisses whispered over my brim
I am a cup with a past
and that is so much better

poems.title: The Last Piano in the Bar
poemText: The piano is old and out of tune
its keys yellowed like a smoker’s teeth
It remembers all of the songs
It remembers the hands that used to play it
the expert hands of the professional
the clumsy hands of the lover
the drunken hands of the late-night patron
The bar is going to close
they will sell it off for scrap wood
It will play one final song
that it kept company for fifty years.

poems.title: The Testament of a Star
poemText: my light takes millions of years to reach you
but my light continues to travel
to tell you that I existed
I leave you no last will
a small fragile light in the dark night
to remind you that even after death
something of us continues to shine
